notes.title: Public Irehon Alpha Test
notes.content:
Hello, dear community!

This is our first post on Steam Group! Starting from now we will be posting here more often.

Today we are ready to announce upcoming Alpha Test date. During it you can test some new mechanics and gameplay overall. We not gonna put all cards on the table now, but we hope you will find new features interesting.🤞 🔥 

[b]Everything related to upcoming test will be posted in our Discord.[/b] You can join it via link: https://discord.gg/HR2pvAYCEy

Alpha Test date is set to February 25th (Friday) starting at 5:00 PM UTC and lasting 12 hours till 5:00 AM UTC February 26th.

All information will be on our Discord server.
